title: Missing Rust components installed on demand
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Detect missing rustfmt/clippy/targets and offer the rustup command, or run it with consent, before the gate fails. Tests zc_toolchain_auto_*.
